items.text: WET/Lisbon timezone · easy overlap with EU and the Americas
Portuguese native · English B1/B2 (honest about it)

summary: Hey, I'm Renato, but most people know me as Tim. Senior DevOps Engineer with 8+ years building and scaling cloud platforms for e-commerce, fintech, pharma and logistics. Kubestronaut: all five CNCF Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKAD, CKS, KCNA, KCSA). I've cut deployment time by up to 70% with CI/CD and GitOps, saved real money with FinOps, and moved entire Kubernetes platforms across clouds with barely any downtime. And I truly believe great infrastructure starts with people: transparency, blameless culture and staying calm when things catch fire.

kubernetes.title: Kubernetes Expertise
kubernetes.intro: Kubernetes is my home turf. I'm a CNCF Kubestronaut, one of the engineers worldwide holding all five Kubernetes certifications, and I run it in production every single day, managed and self-hosted.
items: All 5 CNCF certifications (CKA, CKAD, CKS, KCNA, KCSA), plus OCI Kubernetes Specialist
Production experience with EKS, GKE, OKE, K3s, Rancher, ECS and bare-metal clusters
Led full cluster replatforming: EKS/GKE to OKE migration, including MySQL/PostgreSQL with minimal downtime
Security-first mindset (CKS): secrets management, network policies, hardening, supply-chain awareness
GitOps delivery at scale with Argo CD and Flux CD: declarative, auditable, easy to roll back
Cost-aware platform design: rightsizing, autoscaling and FinOps applied directly to cluster workloads

howIWork.title: How I Work
howIWork.intro: Tech skills keep systems running. Emotional intelligence keeps teams running. Here's what working with me looks like:

items.name: Blameless by default
items.description: Incidents are learning opportunities, not trials. I build postmortem cultures where people feel safe telling the truth fast. That's how MTTR actually goes down.

items.name: Mentorship & hiring
items.description: Currently leading the expansion of the Infra/DevOps team at eureciclo: hiring, mentoring and standardizing good practices so the team scales beyond me.

items.name: Calm under pressure
items.description: Years of SRE on-call taught me that a calm voice in an incident channel is worth more than a clever script. I de-escalate first, debug second.

items.name: Tech ↔ business translation
items.description: I explain infrastructure decisions in terms of cost, risk and speed, so non-technical stakeholders can actually make decisions.

items.name: Cross-team enablement
items.description: I measure my success by how autonomous other teams become. Documentation, golden paths and pairing over gatekeeping.

items.name: Grounded & consistent
items.description: Father of three, married to Renata (yes, our names rhyme). Stability, long-term thinking and zero drama on the teams I join.

jobs.summary: Cross-team DevOps/SRE in a multi-cloud environment (AWS, GCP, OCI), owning infrastructure architecture, migration, operations and cost optimization for a fast-growing sustainability scale-up.
highlights: Led multi-cloud Kubernetes replatforming: EKS/GKE to OKE, migrating MySQL/PostgreSQL with minimal downtime
Established GitOps with Argo CD and CI/CD with Bitbucket Pipelines: faster, auditable, reversible deploys
Built observability with Prometheus, Grafana and Alertmanager; defined SLIs/SLOs and cut MTTR
Drove FinOps: rightsizing, reservations, cleanup and cloud provider negotiation with measurable savings
Adopted AI/LLM-assisted engineering for debugging, log analysis and automation workflows
Leading the team's expansion: hiring, mentoring and standardizing DevOps practices

jobs.summary: DevOps consultant for large enterprise clients in pharmacy (Raia Drogasil, Grupo DPSP), transportation and banking, operating complex AWS/GCP cloud-native environments.
highlights: Designed and optimized CI/CD pipelines with GitLab CI, Bitbucket Pipelines and GitHub Actions across multiple teams
Built and scaled Kubernetes/Docker platforms for high-traffic e-commerce and core-business workloads
Implemented observability with Datadog, AppDynamics, ELK stack, Prometheus and Grafana
Provisioned environments as code with Terraform and CloudFormation
Adapted solutions across industries and stakeholders. Consulting sharpened my communication as much as my engineering.

jobs.summary: Core DevOps engineer for TempoTem, a high-growth startup, owning infrastructure and security decisions from the earliest stages.
highlights: Designed scalable AWS infrastructure supporting rapid product growth
Ran containerized workloads with Docker and Kubernetes; CI/CD with Bitbucket Pipelines
Delivered full observability: Elasticsearch, Kibana, Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager and Instana
Contributed to security and architecture decisions from day one; supported frontend delivery via Vercel

jobs.summary: DevOps for major enterprise clients (SKY, Carrefour, Cielo), building automated deployment pipelines for native mobile apps in SCRUM teams.
highlights: Built Jenkins pipelines automating Android/iOS releases end-to-end, cutting manual work and time-to-market
Operated AWS-based infrastructure for high-demand e-commerce platforms
Integrated APM tooling for proactive issue detection

jobs.summary: First SRE role, during the early days of Carrefour's e-commerce in Brazil, building the monitoring and reliability foundations.
highlights: Implemented infrastructure and application monitoring with Zabbix and AppDynamics
Defined reliability metrics supporting tuning and SLAs
Automated operations with shell scripts, cron and Rundeck

jobs.summary: Grew from infrastructure analyst to coordinator, leading field support teams across distribution centers in four Brazilian states for clients like Carrefour, Amazon and Louis Vuitton.
highlights: Led regional support teams ensuring consistent IT delivery in logistics hubs
Managed server provisioning, networking, vendors and contracts
Bridged technical teams and logistics leadership to align infrastructure with SLAs
